name: Naruto Heroes
description: Three hidden villages from Naruto as playable towns: Konohagakure, Sunagakure and Kirigakure, each with 14 shinobi creatures and its own heroes, plus neutral ninja, four tailed-beast bosses and 43 artifacts, including three Kage sets.
author: Anton Morozov

1.1.2: Monsters stand on the tile you click (they were drawn one tile to the right, so a guard could look hidden in the trees)
Shadow of the Akatsuki: Deidara guards the cave with his clay clones (four Akatsuki Members); map titles fit the scenario header
1.1.1: Map towns and dwellings blend into the terrain (faded ground plates, shadows from the buildings only); a dwelling's drawn door is where a hero enters
Portraits of the ninja cat, ninja hound, Shukaku, Isobu, Gyuki and Gaara's sand tsunami show their heads
Maps: walls of trees and mountains only, so guarded passages read clearly; no tree or bush hides a monster
1.1.0: Animated battle figures for 56 of the 57 creatures (all but Shukaku): idle, walk, attack, hit, defend, death and, for shooters, a throw or cast
Shots start from the animated figures' hands
1.0.0: 11 neutral creatures with their map lairs, and the tailed-beast bosses Shukaku, Isobu, Gyuki and Kurama
43 artifacts, including the Hokage, Kazekage and Mizukage sets that combine into Will of Fire, Sand Coffin and Bloody Mist
All art from the artist: battle and map sprites for every creature, projectiles, specialty icons, map towns and dwellings with owner flags
Balance checked against the original towns: creature stats, costs and growth, hero classes, building costs
0.4.0: Sunagakure and Kirigakure towns: 28 creatures, 4 hero classes, 26 heroes, town screens from the artist
0.3.0: Hero and creature portraits from the generated art
Static battle sprites for the Konohagakure creatures
Kurama, the first tailed-beast boss, with rendered animation
0.2.0: Konohagakure town: 14 creatures, 2 hero classes, 25 heroes, borrowed original graphics

russian.name: Герои Наруто
russian.description: Три скрытые деревни из «Наруто» как играбельные города: Коноха, Суна и Кири, в каждой 14 существ-шиноби и свои герои; а ещё нейтральные ниндзя, четыре хвостатых зверя-босса и 43 артефакта, в том числе три сета Каге.
